application: Thermal engineering-unit conversion for four modules with four sensor channels each

requirements.representation: one delivered exact calibration output per ADC code per channel; no certified compressed representation
requirements.selection: largest integer number of existing epochs satisfying cycle+deadline <= freshness bound, before price screen
requirements.retention: T; there is no minimum refresh rate, CRC/read is not E
requirements.scratch_note: 16 raw uint16 +16 calibrated uint32 +4-byte transfer accumulator; OS/cFE metadata and stacks additional unknown

cfe.load_source: file/NVM, no third full protected-SRAM table image
cfe.update: pin active image for the complete 16-channel cycle; validate inactive; release active; swap only at cycle boundary
cfe.workers: control task and bounded lower-priority maintenance worker in same owning application; port scheduling is a condition, not a measured fact
cfe.transfer_condition: byte accesses may require four full-word ECC transactions; partial write is correct decode/merge/full32 E; no extra retries or opaque full-table copies
cfe.validation: CRC after load plus independent validation CRC and one range/monotonicity pass; explicit application wrapper supplies any missing pass
cfe.startup: accepted W initial encodes/writes paid separately; conservatively add two complete load/validation attempts before t=0

schedule.runtime_read_slots: first channels epochs of every cycle; sample channel immediately before its lookup
schedule.maintenance: one transaction at a time; use only unoccupied read slots and original write slots; finish current transaction before offering next
schedule.offer_deadline_scope: 3000ns from each admitted transaction; 1800s full image workflow bound is separate
schedule.addresses: runtime active_base+channel*4096+adc_code; maintenance ascending index in chosen active/inactive bank; addresses need not match old 5*j permutation
schedule.optional_update_schedule: at most one attempt in each 30-day bucket, released at bucket start if a command is queued; no guaranteed update
schedule.activation: after validation, between complete cycles; invalid or incomplete candidate never active

numerical.analysis: interval/count calculation, no Monte Carlo, no mission-epoch enumeration
